messages:
maria_support: FYI got a customer ticket — embeddings endpoint returning 400 on a small batch. They sent an array with an empty string and null in it. Error from the API: 400 Bad Request - "Invalid input: element 0 is empty; element 1 is null". Can someone help with repro + recommended message for the customer?

kenji_repro: Can you paste the exact payload the customer sent? most of these are double-encoding or a client-side filter bug.

maria_support: Sure — here's what they pasted into the ticket (redacted key):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input": ["", null, "Hi there"]}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```

maria_support: And the body of the response we returned: `HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request`
```json
{"error":"Invalid input: element 0 is an empty string; element 1 is null; expected non-empty string"}
```

tj_eng: Two quick notes: (1) we should treat empty string/null as client input sanitization issues and return a clearer suggestion (filter or coerce); (2) double-encoded strings (eg. JSON.stringify on each element) often show up as extra quotes but that's not the case here.

kenji_repro: I repro'd locally by sending that exact curl — got the same 400. I also tested Node fetch + an example bad client snippet:
```js
// bad client transform
const inputs = raw.map(s => JSON.stringify(s)); // ❌ turns "foo" into '"foo"'
await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify({ input: inputs }) });
```
That makes debugging noisy.

tj_eng: Good find. For this ticket it's simpler: filter null/empty before sending. Suggest this snippet to customer:
```js
const filtered = inputs.filter(x => typeof x === 'string' && x.trim().length > 0);
// if you only have a single item, still send as array: { input: [text] }
```
Also remind them to not JSON.stringify individual elements.

maria_support: I replied to the customer with the filter snippet and included a corrected curl example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input": ["Hi there"]}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```

maria_support: Customer confirmed that removing null and empty strings fixed the 400 and batching resumed normally. They said the bug came from a CSV import that produced empty rows and explicit nulls.

tj_eng: I'll open a small UX/infra improvement: make the error message actionable and include index + example of offending value. Filing EMB-423.

ops-bot: Ticket EMB-423 created by tj_eng — assigned to eng-ml. Summary: improve embeddings API error for null/empty items in batch payload.

tj_eng: I'll add unit tests to cover null/empty elements and update docs to recommend the pre-filter step.

maria_support: Thanks all — closing the internal thread once EMB-423 has an ETA. :thumbsup:
